reviews.title: Great Server Fans!!!
reviews.comment: Excellent server fan! Plenty of static pressure. Very quiet even at high RPM for a 140mm fan.
reviews.author: DW

reviews.title: Great fans, packaging can be improved
reviews.comment:
Great powerful fans. Silent at low rpm and powerful at high speed.
Would be perfect with better packaging which reduces the possibility of bearing damage
reviews.author: WS

reviews.title: Not recommended.
reviews.comment: Should've listened to the other reviews when I purchased this. High pitched squealing that didn't go away. Spend a little extra and get something else.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: WAY too loud
reviews.comment: I wish I would have realized this is a ball bearing fan before I bought it, it's so loud! I have tried 3 types of Arctic fans, the P14, the P14 pro, and the original P12 max with ball bearings . The P12 max and P14 pro are unbearably loud. I stupidly assumed this was a FDB bearing fan since Arctic learned their lesson with the outrageously loud P12 Max and switched it to a FDB bearing, but nope, it's a ball bearing fan, and boy does it scream. Even when I turn it down to 1700 RPMs like a normal P14 it's way louder because of the ball bearing noise. Ball bearing fans are for servers, not PCs.
reviews.author: J
